programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop who always neglects his wife is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. Though he miraculously survives, he must depend on his wife to nurse him back to health. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: Open the Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its "Cop Shop Babes" as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat - can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Green Wood Robbery
programme.desc: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter -the sole witness- mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognize.

programme.title: Bunshinsaba: Hoichi the Earless
programme.desc: You Mei brings home an abandoned doll found on the street. Little does she know that it is possessed by an evil spirit which causes the sudden death of her colleague. You Mei seeks help from a ghost hunter who unleashes the pencil spirit to fight against the evil spirit, unfortunately leading to a series of terrifying events...

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school’s stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperor’s eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.title: Mr Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: A Buddhist monk and Taoist priest put aside their differences to take on vampires that have been struck by lightning and have now become a super powered threat to mankind.

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuk's pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk and falling asleep in her bedroom.

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women’s Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei’s father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: So was born a nobleman but is relegated to a beggar after being caught cheating. He becomes the chief of the Beggar’s gang when he saves the gang’s elder. One day, So foils an assassination attempt on the Emperor and is allowed to reinstate his status but he declines. He is then rewarded with an imperial beggar bowl and lives happily ever after.

programme.title: Those Were the Days
programme.desc: Director Wong despises Cantonese movies of the 60s, but accidentally travels back in time to that movie set. He meets Director Chu, who tells him he can return to modern time if someone likes the film he makes. Wong meets four classic movie stars and invites them to star in his new film, but it flops unexpectedly. Can Wong return to the present?

programme.title: Those Were the Days
programme.desc: Director Wong despises Cantonese movies of the 60s, but accidentally travels back in time to that movie set. He meets Director Chu, who tells him he can return to modern time if someone likes the film he makes. Wong meets four classic movie stars and invites them to star in his new film, but it flops unexpectedly. Can Wong return to the present?

programme.title: WIFI
programme.desc: Li Hong Shan’s wife died in a car accident. One year later, he suddenly receives a message from his dead wife. Li vows to save his wife's life through this time transcending WIFI signal, but ends up uncovering a bigger conspiracy behind...

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Comparing to the director's previous Hex. This time, however, the stakes are even higher and the gruesome goings-on even more memorable. It all starts when a noble police detective starts investigating a child killer's claims of an evil spell, then it doesn't let up until the final, bloated, maggot-ridden cadaver falls.

programme.title: The Revenge
programme.desc: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes on a job as a night guard. As the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at the abandoned building, only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from "The Sutra of 42 Chapters".

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Uncle Hua is a retired agent who owns an antique shop on an old street. When the old street is forcibly demolished by the local Green Dragon Gang one day, Uncle Hua’s hidden identity is accidentally revealed, and he is pursued by a mysterious organization headed by Ah Jie. A fatal duel has just begun!

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him...

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Man’s father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes...

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Man's best friend.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley’s mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Shui and Tai are lovers who grew up together in a village but move to the city as Tai's father disapproves of their relationship. Tai secretly works in a nightclub to help finance Shui to get the job of a salesman. When Shui is promoted for his good work and finds himself progressing in his career, he begins to feel distant from Tai...

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Shui and Tai are lovers who grew up together in a village but move to the city as Tai's father disapproves of their relationship. Tai secretly works in a nightclub to help finance Shui to get the job of a salesman. When Shui is promoted for his good work and finds himself progressing in his career, he begins to feel distant from Tai...

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveler
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: Whisper of Silent Body
programme.desc: Renowned as the "corpse whisperer," forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min is admitted to a hospital, but mysteriously falls to her death at night. Rumour has it that the hospital is haunted. Subsequently, Min's photographer begins receiving eerie phone calls, the writer loses consciousness in a bizarre car accident, and her friend mysteriously disappears...

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchant's mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation...

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to "Casino Tycoon". 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down...

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: Fist of Legend
programme.desc: When Chen Zhen studies in Japan, he finds several Chinese students missing and accidentally uncovers the Black Dragon Society’s conspiracy. A new drug is invented to boost bodies of the Japanese troops in war and the Chinese students are used in their experiments. Chen Zhen vows to take down the evil society and destroy their secret laboratory.

programme.title: Love and Let Love!
programme.desc: Cliff proposes to his girlfriend Terry but is killed in a car accident before she says "yes". Terry is devastated and inconsolable. When Cliff's ghost returns, they seem to go back to their good old days. However, Cliff is determined to help Terry get over his death and start anew.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam’s life. Ma’s fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A gambling master and his partner are hired by the government to investigate another gambler who may be working as a Japanese spy in Shanghai.

programme.title: Oily Maniac
programme.desc: Famous director Ho Meng-hua, who gave Jackie Chan and Sammo Hung acting breaks in his early kung-fu films, broke new ground with his horror hit Oily Maniac. Based on a true story about a creature that kills people at night and covers them in oil, it stars young actor Danny Lee (aka. Li Hsiu-hsien) as the oily maniac. It was considered so scary that it was censored drastically.

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Angor Management
programme.desc: Jim and Strickler team up to bring down Angor Rot Meanwhile the Gnome returns with important information regarding Baby Enrique.

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S1 - A Night To Remember
programme.desc: Jim must convince Strickler to cut the bond to his mom while Claire and Toby sneak into his office during the Spring Fling Dance for the incantation.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - RoboCleve
programme.desc: The kids hatch a plan to take down Cleve and rescue Ms. Nowhere and Gary. Meanwhile, despite interference from Ziri, Cleve successfully begins to launch his satellites into space, which will allow him to use his weather machine to destroy Earth’s major cities and transform the Sahara into the only oasis. In order to stop the satellites, the team engages in an all-out battle against Cleve, Matsuo, and Rafaela.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - Sirocco Fire Explosion
programme.desc: Cleve has the team surrounded - is this the end? Suddenly, Cisco bursts in to save the day, along with all of the friends the team has made along the way in the Sahara. Working together, they manage to stop Cleve’s missiles and defeat Rafaela and Matsuo. But before they get a chance to celebrate, a giant fire tornado tears its way through the Sahara destroying everything in its path. Tony decides to make one last daring attempt in order to save the day.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - Chasing Phantoms
programme.desc: After an epic chase around the globe, the team finally catches Rafaela, making it Ms. Nowhere's 100th arrest - and the agency is throwing her a party! Meanwhile, Cisco's uncle Tuco, a famous luchador in Mexico, is visiting town promoting his next show. But the celebration comes to a halt when there's an explosion at the party and an attack by a mysterious group of criminals!

programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On! S2 - Bad Luck Branch Gem Day
programme.desc: Branch becomes convinced he has bad luck, and endeavors to reverse his fortunes. It is Branch’s Gem day (an important day during which he will be presented with his unique ‘Gem’), and Poppy wants to make sure everything goes perfectly. Unfortunately, she loses Branch’s gem, and must recruit her friends to help her find it again.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free: Riding Academy S3 - Race To The Finish Part 1
programme.desc: The girls get summer jobs to help Lucky repair the sprawling house she inherited from her grandfather near the Rosemead Valley Racetrack.

programme.title: Voltron: Legendary Defender S3 - Know Your Enemy
programme.desc: The Lions form Voltron and head toward Earth, but must rethink their strategy after receiving a message from Sam

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - A Bed For Raffi
programme.desc: Apartment renovations find Raffi in search of a place to stay for a few days. The popular, even-keeled Raffi turns out to be an impossible houseguest, quickly burning bridges with his podmates. In the end, not even Birch can stand the thought of another night having to house Pod 4's resident Mr. Perfect.

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - Back To The Stone Age
programme.desc: When the janitor is the subject of ridicule in a widely spread cell phone picture, Principal Lemmon bans all electronic devices. Soon Cosmos High's extra controlling head honcho is faced with the decision whether or not life can go on without her beloved walkie-talkie. As technological abilities plunge, tempers escalate and a student revolt ensues.

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - The Costume Party
programme.desc: Grounded from attending Dave's costume party, Birch sneaks out with the help of her podmates. A series of unforeseen circumstances sees the evening turn into an Odyssey for the podmates. And while it's not exactly what they planned, it's not all bad until they discover Birch has to end the evening by "breaking-in" to her own house.

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - Integrity Insmegrity
programme.desc: Creative integrity gets a workout when Liam and Birch's Manga ends up in the pages of the local alternative magazine. Soon publisher pressure has Liam and Birch questioning their creative vision and how much they're willing to compromise. Of course, the two can't possibly be on the same side at the same time.

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S3 - Shadows
programme.desc: Webby is clearing out her web. Fifi takes all the unwanted objects home and uses them to play a brilliant game of shadow puppets, a perfect game to play on a rainy day!

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S3 - Buttercup Bad Wolf
programme.desc: The twins are playing "The Three Little Pigs". Buttercup is enjoying her role as the big bad wolf rather too much and scares poor Daisy. Will Buttercup realise how upset her sister is?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Runaway Mo
programme.desc: Stingo is bored, he wants something exciting to do. He decides to take Mo for a spin without asking Fifi first. All goes wrong when Mo gets out of control. Can the tots stop the runaway mower?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Stingo's Enormous Carrot
programme.desc: Pip is trying hard to grow some vegetables. But however hard he tries, they don't seem to get any bigger. But Stingo's vegetable patch next door appears to be doing suspiciously well.

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Fifi's Pancake Fun
programme.desc: Fifi and Pip are busy making pancakes. But every time they flip one it disappears, where could they be going?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Pip's Pony
programme.desc: Pip wants a pony. He tries adapting his scooter and Violet even makes him a hobby horse. But nothing is quite right. Until Fifi points out the silver horse made out of stars in the night sky.

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Aunt Tulip's Carnival
programme.desc: All the tots are excited as Aunt Tulip is holding a Caribbean themed carnival. But will the weather hold long enough for them to have their celebrations?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Storm
programme.desc: It is a windy day in the garden, Fifi's washing has blown away. Poppy offers to find it, but she gets caught in the storm. The other tots set out to find her and spend a wild night out in the open.

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia Explores Outer Space
programme.desc: Olivia is assigned to do a school project based on one of the planets in the solar system, but they're all so interesting, she just can't decide which one! With a little help from her brother Ian, she finds a solution: create a model of the entire solar system, and maybe even discover a brand new planet in the process

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia Goes To The Beach
programme.desc: When Grandma takes Olivia and Ian to a special beach, they're all shocked to find that Grandma's old friend Annette has built a huge fence blocking the best part of the beach. They don't let that stop them from having a good time. Soon with Olivia's prompting, even Annette wants to join in on the fun.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Charged Up
programme.desc: Magnus's superpowered mechano-dragon threatens to replace the Riders. But when it spirals out of control, the town's real heroes have to step up!

programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On! S1 - Big Poppy Neighbor War
programme.desc: When a troll starts to ruin the fun of open mic night Poppy is forced to enter a compliment battle.Branch tries to drive Sky Toronto away when he moves next door.

programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On! S1 - Remote Out of Control Critter Comfort
programme.desc: Biggie takes Branchs superpowered remote but must return it before Branch finds outWhen Poppy builds a new home for a group of cute critters she accidentally attracts their predators.

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S2 - Humanspeople Safari Happy Space Troopers
programme.desc: Oh introduces Tip to the strange world of Boovian Earth tours; Rejected by the Junior Lady Rangers, Oh and Tip form their own all-inclusive scouts, sparking a turf war

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S2 - Krebbles Is Real Tip's Diary
programme.desc: When Oh thinks that his favorite TV show is real, Tip tries to maintain the illusion; When Tip's diary gets boring for Oh, he decides to create drama in her life to liven up his favorite book

programme.title: Dinotrux Supercharged S3 - Goldtrux
programme.desc: Waldos new fancy gadget gets noticed by a truck who is obsessed with gold and only in it for himself

programme.title: Dinotrux Supercharged S3 - Clifthanger
programme.desc: Skya and Ace accompany a Pteracopter outside the crater to help uncover a cache of ore only to discover something unexpected

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Spark Bees Best in Show
programme.desc: The kids scare away a swarm of bees. But when they realize bees make the flowers happy, they hatch a plan to get them back! When Scallop makes a bad choice, Kelp helps her learn from her mistakes.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Superfan Barb
programme.desc: Kelp and the rest of his friends put on a game of rainbow ball, but Kelp begins to wonder how well his special spark can help him truly measure up to his favorite player. When the underwater friends meet someone new, they’re reminded that their differences make them unique.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - New Hat, New Tag! Furry Tail Ending
programme.desc: When Tag worries that she's no longer a "Go" dog, Lady Lydia helps her find a new persona by helping Tag try on a bunch of different hats. Luckily, when a runaway puppy needs to be wrangled, and only the speedy Tag can catch him, Tag realizes she was a Go dog all along. \ Sergeant Pooch reads Scooch, Tag and Kit a story book during their sleepover. But when the last pages are missing, the three kids work together to make up their own ending to the story.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Bigpaw, Big Problems Captain Scooch and Scally-Tag
programme.desc: Tag, Scooch and Kit think they found the perfect story for their newspaper: Bigpaw is in Pawston! But when they find out that Frank and Beans were lying to the town, they seek to uncover the truth and reveal it to everyone. \ When Sam Whippet sets up a pirate-themed race for the Race Cadets, pirate-loving Scooch takes on the role of captain. Tag struggles to take orders as first mate while helping Scooch navigate maritime obstacles and avoid the fearsome pirates.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Lost and Found In the Park In the Dark
programme.desc: The Community Center's Lost and Found is full and it's up to the gang to use their detective skills and return the lost items to their original owners. Rodney only needs one more bird on his birdwatching list, but the only problem is that it only comes out at night! Team Zenko must help Rodney face his fear of the dark so he can get the last picture for his collection.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Longest Yardwork The Girl Who Cried Goose
programme.desc: Donna plans a garden party for Rona, but the only problem is that her garden is overgrown and neglected. The team try to transform this jungle into a backyard just in time for the party. Lula finds an angry goose on the loose, and Team Zenko need to get it out of the park before soccer camp starts.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Where’s The Party? The Noisiest Night
programme.desc: When Marcus loses an invitation to a birthday party and doesn’t know where it will take place, the Dew Drops set out to find the location and get Marcus to the party on time. When Harper can’t sleep because of a strange noise in her room, the Dews must figure out the source.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Escape The Backpack Play Date
programme.desc: While helping Lola pack for her first day of camp, the Dews get stuck inside her backpack! Using the random items inside, the Dews get crafty in their attempt to break out. When Eden and Phoebe join Harper and Marcus for a playdate, the Dews disagree on what activity their kids should do, ultimately learning that there are lots of ways to play!

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S1 - Friday Night Liyotes
programme.desc: When Grug won't let her join his winning team, Eep forms her own underdog team in the first-ever sports competition - Ahhh! Valley's annual Egg Toss.

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S1 - The Crood Who Knew Too Much Scent Of A Thunk
programme.desc: When Thunk is so stinky he kills animals with his stench, he pretends to be a great hunter; A spider ant bite gives Grug the biggest brain in town.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - War of the Cheeks
programme.desc: Boss searches for evidence that Tabitha's best friend is an Uncuddleable, but is sidetracked by a Templeton Family tradition: "The War of the Cheeks", a Go Fish tournament where the winner gets to make family rules for a whole day. When Yvette joins in, Boss has to keep her from winning, out of fear that an evil babysitter will make family rules that overturn the Templeton household.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Techy Tykes
programme.desc: Trying to win Tabitha's loyalty for Baby Corp, Boss and Tina invite her to Techy Tykes, a technology convention at their office. But when the top-secret UBO goes missing, the outsiders Tabitha and Tim (who's tagged along to relive his glory days) immediately become the number one suspects.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S3 - Darkest Night
programme.desc: When Stoick is shot down Hiccup and the riders race back to Berk to help

programme.desc: Shashi stages a race up the privately-owned Mount Zebulon, and he invites Tony, Cisco, and Margaret "Echo" Pearl to participate. The crew soon discovers that Shashi is using the race to steal another super-car (this time from space!) - and he knows that Tony is working with the feds.

programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On! S2 - Friend MatchingTrolly Tales 3
programme.desc: When a friend-matching quiz Poppy surreptitiously gives the Trolls reveals that Sky and Guy are a near perfect match, she sets out to make them friends! But her attempts to foster a relationship keep backfiring.Branch and Poppy try to entertain Trolls Village’s babies with a series of nursery rhymes. But, stalling for time, they expand each into a distinct, Trolls-y story.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free: Riding Academy S3 - Home Is Where The Herd Is
programme.desc: With academy life on the horizon, the PALs work together to tame wild yearling Governor before they leave. But maybe he's not meant to be broken.

programme.title: Voltron: Legendary Defender S3 - Trial by Fire
programme.desc: The Paladins struggle to escape after Sendak captures them, their lions, and Admiral Sanda

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - Skate Club
programme.desc: Sandra insists on breaking the gender barrier of a "boys only" skateboard race. But the race is one with a history for being incredibly dangerous. Will Sandra let Liam "save" her or will she save her reputation as the coolest sk8terchick at Cosmos High?

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - Pinged And Ponged
programme.desc: A little white lie told to his ping-pong loving grandmother forces Raffi to actually try out for the team when they make the finals. Grandma is keen to see her favourite grandson play her favourite sport and he's not about to let her down. It soon becomes apparent that normally athletic Raffi is all thumbs when it comes to what team captain Antoine pretentiously refers to as table tennis.

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - Love Is In The Air
programme.desc: Spring has sprung and love is in the air at Cosmos High. When the other pods pressure Sandra and Raffi to couple-up, lovelorn Birch and Liam decide to take matters into their own hands ensuring that the reluctant pair don't end up together.

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - Cyranette
programme.desc: A cute guy into comics mistakes Birch's artwork as Sandra's comic. When the ruse is revealed, he falls for Birch. Sandra's ire rises, but both girls ultimately find out they've got a High School Lothario on their hands and reveal him to the sisterhood of Cosmos High.

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S3 - Poppy's Ice Cream Show
programme.desc: All the tots are picking fruit so Poppy can use it to make her famous ice cream. Stingo thinks he has come up with a much better plan to get hold of some ice cream without having to pick anything… will it work?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S3 - Painting Practice
programme.desc: Fifi wants to repaint her kitchen but Poppy has run out of paint. Can anybody else come up with an idea to brighten up her walls?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Lovelorn Slugsy
programme.desc: Slugsy is having trouble courting Primrose. Stingo's cousin Hornetto offers to help him. But could he be up to no good?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Fifi's Snowy Fun
programme.desc: It has snowed in Flowertot Garden and all the tots are having fun… except Primrose who is worried she'll get dirty. Can the other tots convince her to play with them?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Mystery In Flowertot Garden
programme.desc: Somebody has been going through the tots' bins every night in Flowertot Garden. The tots turn detective to see if they can discover who the culprit is.

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Stingo Cleans Up
programme.desc: Diggly has had enough of the heap of unwanted items next to his compost heap. Stingo decides to "resell" them to the other tots and unwittingly helps everybody out!

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - My Fair Bumble
programme.desc: Bumble has been asked to Aunt Tulip's for tea but he is worried that his manners are not up to scratch. He asks the other tots to help him out.

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Pineapple Palace Panic
programme.desc: Fifi is supposed to be babysitting Grubby, but she's forgotten! Stingo and Slugsy step in to cover for her, with disastrous results!

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia Plays The Piano
programme.desc: Olivia sees herself as a great concert pianist, though her piano teacher thinks she needs a little more practice. But when her little brother Ian begins taking his own piano lessons - and turns out to be pretty good - Olivia isn't sure if there's room for two prodigies in the family.

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia Plays Football
programme.desc: Francine is chosen to play goalie, and Olivia is disappointed that she doesn't get to wear the red goalie jersey. Even worse, the uniform she designs for herself only causes chaos and confusion among her teammates. But when Francine is better at dodging the ball than stopping it, it's up to Olivia to put on the red goalie jersey and save the day

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Game of Horns
programme.desc: At a big town festival, Magnus challenges Duggard in a competition to be chief of Huttsgalor! Can the Riders help their friend keep his helmet?

programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On! S1 - Model Behavior Pillow Fight Club
programme.desc: Satin and Chenille put on a fashion show to impress the trendsetter of Troll VillagePoppy and Branch start a massive villagewide pillow battle to determine who gets the pillow of destiny.

programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On! S1 - The Imposter Frenemy
programme.desc: When there is an imposter in Troll Village, Branch and Poppy embark on a man-hunt as to try to keep the Trolls from realizing that anything is offPoppy discovers that Archer Pastry belongs to a group of evil creatures called the Party Crashers

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S2 - A Thuper Hero Thtory
programme.desc: Tip and Oh's plan to save Elrod turns into a battle to save earth from Elrod

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S2 - Friend Like Tip Like Mother, Like Pit Of Fire
programme.desc: Tip meets a surprisingly similar girl which threatens Tip's uniqueness When Tip and Die-Anne refuse to "be like their moms", they end up finding themselves in a dangerous situation

programme.title: Dinotrux Supercharged S3 - Bad Build
programme.desc: When the Dinotruxs own talents are used against them Ty realizes that truxing it up may not always be the best plan

programme.title: Dinotrux S3 - Renegades
programme.desc: On the run from D-Structs and D-Stroy, the Trux devise a plan to build an awesome hideaway so they can lead a rebellion from a safe, secure location.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Somewhere Over the Rainbow
programme.desc: Kelp is swept by an ocean current to the shore of Unicorn Land where he sees a majestic creature on a cliff that looks just like him, but not like his Narwhal family under the sea. Kelp tells his family he’s a unicorn. Kelp returns to Unicorn Land where he meets Pixie and Juniper, who show him around and introduce him to unicorn spark and magic.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Tacos Rainy Day
programme.desc: When Kelp is introduced to crunchy tacos in Unicorn Land, he must use his bubble sparks to bring them back to his family underwater. Kelp’s unicorn friends are going to teach him Swishbee on land. But it rains and the game is called off until Kelp shows them that playing in the water can be even more fun.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Welcome to Pawston \ Ruff Day on the Job
programme.desc: Tag wants to bring her new neighbor, Scooch, to the Party in the Tree. But a series of traffic jams make Tag impatient, and she keeps trying to find different ways to get to the party. Thanks to Tag’s handiness - and one of Lady Lydia’s hats - they make it to the party just in time. \ Pawston’s new canine mail carrier keeps getting chased by dogs, so Tag and Scooch have to help him deliver the mail.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Dark Park Bark Lark \ The Fast and the Curious
programme.desc: Tag and Scooch team up to get all of Scooch's chores done in time for the Barkapellas Bark In the Park In the Dark concert. \ Tag is so excited to join the Sam Whippet’s Race Cadets. But when Tag and Scooch show up at the racetrack, there’s lots of competition. And to complete the first challenge - a pedal car race - they’re going to have to work together.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Photo Day Disaster The Eightful Eight
programme.desc: When Rodney heads to the Community Center for Junior Security Cadet picture day, TZG secretly helps him stay neat and clean for the photo shoot. When Luis worries about his first ever math test, TZG secretly helps steady his nerves.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Robo-Dog Day Afternoon Spoiler Alert
programme.desc: New girl in town Felicia shows off her robo-dog but it runs out of control, and TZG must secretly stop the barking bot from wreaking havoc. When Lula starts gathering birthday wishes from folks around town, TZG secretly keeps her surprise party under wraps.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - The Cleat without Feet Real Magic
programme.desc: When Phoebe accidentally knocks Harper's soccer cleat off the balcony before the big game, the Dew Drops must venture into the city to retrieve the cleat. When Dylan starts practicing magic tricks, Athena thinks his magic is real! But when the Dew Drops investigate his "magic hat," they accidentally break it and must fix it before Dylan’s magic show for the neighborhood kids.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - The Sleepover Save The Very Hungry Vacuum
programme.desc: Marcus is having his first sleepover and Phoebe is concerned that Marcus may be nervous so Phoebe sets out to make sure he has the best first sleepover ever. When Athena’s magical jump rope gets sucked up by the family’s new robot vacuum, she loses confidence in her abilities, only to learn that her real abilities are already inside her.

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S1 - It Crushes Rebel Without A Paws
programme.desc: Eep gets struck with the crush curse when cute new guy, Kevin, comes to Ahhh! Valley. Her and Grug do everything they can to break the curse's hold Thunk starts to hang out with liyotes against Grug's wishes when he has a hard time fitting in with kids from school.

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S1 - Grug Vs Math Footless
programme.desc: Amber announces that math is the new skill that every hunter must have. Grug cannot seems to grasp the concept and enlists Squawk to help himGrug and Snoot ban dancing when it causes a rock slide. Eep sets up an underground dance club against the adults' wishes.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - The Big Dumpling
programme.desc: The Uncuddleables have struck the Lil Dumpling baby pageant, replacing all of Baby Corp's super-cute top 5%er babies with not-cute bottom 5%ers. Boss, Tina and their field team race to caravan the 5%ers from their homes to the pageant before Nannycam deploys the nuclear option of unleashing the dangerously cute UBO on stage to salvage a Lil Dumpling win.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - The Great Medieval London Fire 1135
programme.desc: Boss Baby and Tina reject the 5%er system that says the cuter you are, the more love you deserve. Teaming up with the Uncuddleables, the team tries to take down the system from within, forming a resistance of the eight department heads of Baby Corp in the hopes of changing the way we look at Baby Love forever.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S3 - Living On The Edge
programme.desc: With their enemies defeated and the volcano erupting on Dragon's Edge, the riders decide to return to Berk but Hiccup discovers that the Dragon Hunters are still out there

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S3 - Sandbusted
programme.desc: When Hiccup is summoned to the Northern Markets to look into a curse that causes people to disappear, he is sucked down into a cavern of the fearsome Sandbuster

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Kitty School
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a school notebook and lunch box, it's Kitty School Day in the dollhouse! Gabby and Pandy head to different classes held by the Gabby Cats to learn and live a day in the life of a student.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Kitty Cat Cam
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a new camera that takes pictures with silly filters, CatRat uses it to lead Gabby, Pandy, and the Gabby Cats on a photographic scavenger hunt around the dollhouse!

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - The Stroll
programme.desc: Tina and Boss adjust to co-boss responsibilities while on a mission to rescue the baby with the best hair in the world from a lice outbreak. With opposing leadership views, the two split the existing field team's focus and discover a new archenemy in Lumpy the Park Duck.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Potty Mouth
programme.desc: After a baby says a swear word on live television (censored by child-friendly online filter Sheriff Potty Pardner), Boss becomes obsessed with proving that the baby was taught this filth by their new arch-nemesis, Lumpy the Park Duck. Meanwhile, Tina's search to find what that swear word means creates unintentional havoc for both Tabitha's research paper and for Baby Corp's online systems when Sheriff Potty Pardner gives them an "internet time out"

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Imaginary Friends
programme.desc: After Boss insults Tina's imaginary friend, he's forced into "Imaginary Friend Sensitivity Training" at Baby Corp. Boss makes up his own imaginary friend to get out of these meetings, but after Tina gets a whiff that he may be lying, he's forced to keep up the charade at work and at home.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - The Final Key
programme.desc: Ms. Nowhere tells the kids that the failed mission is over, but Tony isn’t ready to give up, and he’s determined to rescue Frostee. The crew goes rogue by deciding to steal the final key from Shashi and trade it for their friend.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - Ignition
programme.desc: Shashi finally reveals his master plan.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - The Key To The Strip
programme.desc: The kids battle Shashi in Las Vegas as Shashi tries to take down evil billionaire Cleve and use Skeleton Key to create a new world order. Frostee has a plan to get Skeleton Key offline, but it only gives Tony ten seconds to take Shashi out and save the world.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S2 - The Trial of Mr. Ping
programme.desc: There is more epic action and intrigue as Po and the Dragon Knights continue their quest to destroy the Tianshang weapons, but find themselves in treacherous waters when they are captured by pirates, one of which is out for revenge against Mr. Ping! The adventures lead them to London, where they are wanted by the Knights. Old enemies resurface and Blade will have to face one of her most challenging opponents-her mom.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S2 - Baddie Issues
programme.desc: There is more epic action and intrigue as Po and the Dragon Knights continue their quest to destroy the Tianshang weapons, but find themselves in treacherous waters when they are captured by pirates, one of which is out for revenge against Mr. Ping! The adventures lead them to London, where they are wanted by the Knights. Old enemies resurface and Blade will have to face one of her most challenging opponents-her mom.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S2 - A Family Friend
programme.desc: There is more epic action and intrigue as Po and the Dragon Knights continue their quest to destroy the Tianshang weapons, but find themselves in treacherous waters when they are captured by pirates, one of which is out for revenge against Mr. Ping! The adventures lead them to London, where they are wanted by the Knights. Old enemies resurface and Blade will have to face one of her most challenging opponents-her mom.

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S1 - Mom Genes
programme.desc: When Grug takes Ugga hunting to find her inner growl again, she's as fierce as ever until coming face-to-face with a mom and baby too cute to catch.

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S1 - Night Of The Living Croods Spoonful Of Soo-Gar
programme.desc: When The Croods experience the first-ever sugar-rush, they're hooked on the delicious new food; Grug is labeled a zombie after taking the first nap.

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S1 - Friday Night Liyotes
programme.desc: When Grug won't let her join his winning team, Eep forms her own underdog team in the first-ever sports competition - Ahhh! Valley's annual Egg Toss.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Troublesome Treachery of the Thieving Toot Fairy
programme.desc: George and Harold race against Mr. Krupp to try to get him fired before they get expelled

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Tenuous Takedown of the Tyrannical Teachertrons
programme.desc: In the season opener, George and Harold have returned to school due to a technicality, but the school has been taken over by Melvin and a cyborg Melvin from the future! Their goal is to make the school extremely difficult by replacing all the teachers with Teachertron robots. Suffering under the new regime and without Mr. KruppCaptain Underpants on hand to help, the boys hypnotize gym teacher Mr. Meaner and turn him into Sergeant Boxers to fight back.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Frantic Fury of the Fearsome Furculees
programme.desc: Tired of the Melvins ruling the school, the boys realize that they need Mr. Krupp to make the school at least bearable. Unfortunately, Krupp has run off to Ecuador to look for a fabled fountain. So the boys form the M.I.S.F.A.R.T.S. - Mega Incredible Search Force Adventure Rescue Team Squad - to travel to Ecuador and bring Krupp back, whether he wants it or not.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S3 - In Plain Sight
programme.desc: Hiccup and his crew are in search for dragon eye gems only to discover a spy amongst them In the midst of it all Dagur has run into an old nemesis

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S3 - No Bark, All Bite
programme.desc: Hiccup and Stoick set forth to find willow bark while Gobber holds a cookoff for the merchants until things go a riot and the riders have to protect Berk

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S3 - Chain Of Command
programme.desc: Krogen is on the hunt for dragon lenses and Snotlout and Minden do their best to defend Wing Island. Back in Berk Dagur and Mala feud over keeping the lenses safe

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Win, Lose Or Draal
programme.desc: Everything comes into perspective when Jim discovers his re-match with Draal is to the death.

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S1 - To Catch A Changeling
programme.desc: After Jim finds the Killahead Bridge has been moved, he must use a horseshoe to find who in Arcadia is a changeling.

programme.desc: Once the unsung workhorses of English football, centre-backs have become some of the Premier League's most influential figures. This week, The Art of... sits down with two-time Premier League winner Joleon Lescott to explore how the role has evolved from last-ditch defending to a position that now shapes games, systems and titles. Joleon breaks down some of the key attributes of the role, and examines how the duties of the centre-back have expanded over time.

programme.title: THE BIG INTERVIEW - EP29
programme.desc: Extended sit-downs and more informal 'out and about' interviews with the Premier League's biggest stars, providing players with a platform to tell their story in their own words.

programme.title: FANTASY SHOW - FRI 27 FEB
programme.desc: Haaland or Salah? Saka or Palmer? Isak or Cunha? Picking your Fantasy team is never easy, but the Fantasy Show is on hand to help FPL Managers with those big decisions.

programme.title: FANZONE - FRI 27 FEB
programme.desc: This is the show that puts international fans at the heart of the Premier League conversation. We connect with fans from around the world as they share their views on their teams and favourite players.

programme.desc: Heritage brings you Humayun's tomb from the capital of India,Delhi. A fine specimen of the great Mughal architecture it is said to have inspired major architectural innovations, like the Taj Mahal.

programme.title: Happy Ever After - EP32
programme.desc: TUNG KOON (AU YEUNG CHUN WAH, BOBBY) born with a special ‘King’s Tongue’ is betrayed by his assistant, SIU SIU (CHAN MIU YING, MARIANE) who had prepared some chili source without permission. TUNG is accused of deceiving the Emperor and is forced to flee from Guangzhou to the capital. When SIU discovered that someone had used her to trap TUNG, she sees TUNG in person and apologizes. TUNG and SIU eventually reconcile. Love feeling blossoms between them.

programme.title: Brick Slaves - EP2
programme.desc: LAU YIU-MING (Vincent Wong) exhausts the money that he and his girlfriend have saved for many years to buy a property and is about to get married. Out of the blue, his girlfriend not only wants to break up with him, but also secretly leases the premises out to a piano teacher, CHOI KIN-CHING (Selena Li). Unfortunately, YIU-MING's bad day gets even worse as he is soon laid off from work.

programme.title: The Runner - EP12
programme.desc: Web media editor Ho Ka-yan (Elaine Yiu) encounters track and field coach Yuen Nik (Joel Chan) as she is assigned the task of approaching the Windchasers Club and digging up scandalous dirt. Because of some past regrettable incident, Yuen Nik avoids socializing with other people. But he is getting closer and closer to Ka-yan as he repeatedly mingles with her. Kwok Bui-yee (Tiffany Lau), daughter of tycoon Kwok Wong-po (Ram Chiang), eagerly joins Windchasers as she has some ulterior motive.

programme.title: A STEP INTO THE PAST - EP38
programme.desc: HONG SHIU LUNG (KOO TIN LOK, LOUIS) is an secret agent in the 21st Century. He joins a pilot programme to fly back in time hoping that he will salvage his unforgettable love. However, something goes wrong during the mission. He is sent back to the Warring States Period. Emperor QI (LAM RAYMOND) has not been crowned yet and is kept hostage in Chiu. In order to return to the future, LUNG decides to help QI become emperor. With his wisdom and Kungfu, he is recognized and given important tasks.

programme.title: Law dis-Order - EP14
programme.desc: As the founder of the leading Chinese law firm, CHEUK KAI-YIU (Lau Dan) has been re-elected as chairman of the committee for many terms. Though he promised managing partner LAU KING-CHANG (Liu Kai Chi) that he would step down, he deliberately brings in a materialistic lawyer called CHEUNG KEUNG (Alex Fong) to counterbalance KING-CHANG's obsession with power.

However, something goes wrong during the mission. He is sent back to the Warring States Period. Emperor QI (LAM RAYMOND) has not been crowned yet and is kept hostage in Chiu. In order to return to the future, LUNG decides to help QI become emperor. With his wisdom and Kungfu, he is recognized and given important tasks.

programme.title: Law dis-Order - EP18
programme.desc: As the founder of the leading Chinese law firm, CHEUK KAI-YIU (Lau Dan) has been re-elected as chairman of the committee for many terms. Though he promised managing partner LAU KING-CHANG (Liu Kai Chi) that he would step down, he deliberately brings in a materialistic lawyer called CHEUNG KEUNG (Alex Fong) to counterbalance KING-CHANG's obsession with power.

programme.title: Law dis-Order - EP19
programme.desc: As the founder of the leading Chinese law firm, CHEUK KAI-YIU (Lau Dan) has been re-elected as chairman of the committee for many terms. Though he promised managing partner LAU KING-CHANG (Liu Kai Chi) that he would step down, he deliberately brings in a materialistic lawyer called CHEUNG KEUNG (Alex Fong) to counterbalance KING-CHANG's obsession with power.

programme.title: Happy Ever After - EP34
programme.desc: TUNG KOON (AU YEUNG CHUN WAH, BOBBY) born with a special ‘King’s Tongue’ is betrayed by his assistant, SIU SIU (CHAN MIU YING, MARIANE) who had prepared some chili source without permission. TUNG is accused of deceiving the Emperor and is forced to flee from Guangzhou to the capital. When SIU discovered that someone had used her to trap TUNG, she sees TUNG in person and apologizes. TUNG and SIU eventually reconcile. Love feeling blossoms between them.

programme.title: Brick Slaves - EP4
programme.desc: LAU YIU-MING (Vincent Wong) exhausts the money that he and his girlfriend have saved for many years to buy a property and is about to get married. Out of the blue, his girlfriend not only wants to break up with him, but also secretly leases the premises out to a piano teacher, CHOI KIN-CHING (Selena Li). Unfortunately, YIU-MING's bad day gets even worse as he is soon laid off from work.

programme.title: The Runner - EP14
programme.desc: Web media editor Ho Ka-yan (Elaine Yiu) encounters track and field coach Yuen Nik (Joel Chan) as she is assigned the task of approaching the Windchasers Club and digging up scandalous dirt. Because of some past regrettable incident, Yuen Nik avoids socializing with other people. But he is getting closer and closer to Ka-yan as he repeatedly mingles with her. Kwok Bui-yee (Tiffany Lau), daughter of tycoon Kwok Wong-po (Ram Chiang), eagerly joins Windchasers as she has some ulterior motive.

programme.title: Rosy Business - EP1
programme.desc: HONG PO KEI’s (Tang Shui Man, Sheren) engagement with Wuxi rice baron TSEUNG KIU (Yueh Wah) broke off many years ago when a natural disaster hit the country. Later when the country was running out of food supply her whole family was killed and she become a criminal. Over the years, KEI has never got over KIU. She has been trying to prove he is not as heartless as the others think. Fate has it that they meet again and she becomes his fourth wife.

programme.title: Battle ATM
programme.desc: Creating a brand-new interactive ATM that combined with puzzle solving and daily life! Guests can win money by taking three rounds of intellectual challenges from the ATM, turn wisdom into money! Futuristic program scenes with video game clearing concept, where challengers engage in the intellectual competition to switch on the ATM. Those who won goes to the ultimate challenge.

programme.title: Have a nice dream
programme.desc: There's a saying that "You can always get inspired by nature." Five outdoor enthusiasts-a cook, an athlete, a photographer, and two ecological experts-plan a two-day trip to enjoy the ultimate getaway in Taiwan. They share mysterious secret spots that have yet to be discovered, and places that are hard to access, featuring breathtaking mountain scenes and some of the bluest waters in the world. They also educate people on how to preserve Taiwan's beautiful and gifted environment.

programme.title: 神奇故事屋第2集
programme.desc: 《神奇故事屋》描述在阿達叔叔的書房裏頭有一個奇幻通道，凡是在這個書房裡讀過的繪本，皆可以透過這個隧道進入到繪本的世界裏頭。故事屋就像時空任意門，帶他們到一個個不同的繪本中旅行。於是，孩子們跟著阿達叔叔進入繪本探險、拜訪台灣各領域的專家、破解歷史的祕密、跟著動物專家上山尋寶……，每一次的冒險都緊張刺激、精采得不得了！

programme.title: 我們這一家第103集
programme.desc: 圍繞花師奶一家四口的生活瑣事，他們既平凡又普通，但卻有無盡的趣事。似曾相識的情節，也許……就是你我身邊的故事！

programme.title: 寶島西米樂守護第189集
programme.desc: 熱鬧的台北太平老街上，少女春燕和母親雅芬穿過擁擠的人群，來到生意興隆、美軍也來光顧的「寶島西服店」，尋找失蹤的父親照清。照清曾在這裡當過學徒，和老闆梅樹師是師兄弟，但因故未能出師…。春燕看著梅樹與曉蘭鶼鰈情深地經營「寶島西服店」，這美好的景象讓春燕想起父親曾向自己承諾，未來若跟著師兄梅樹出師後，自己的西服店也會正式掛牌營業，並收女兒春燕當全台第一位西裝女徒弟，將西裝技藝傳承下去

programme.title: 美麗人生壯志高飛第427集
programme.desc: 台視60周年台慶大戲《美麗人生》第五單元《壯志高飛》，以1960年代高雄市旗津島為故事起點，三位最美麗的台灣女人，在台灣最美麗的年代，在最美麗的旗津，悲歡交織而成的美麗人生。數百年前，旗津還沒有一個統一的名稱，島的南端依舊與高雄相連。 而後，為了建造高雄港第二港口，旗津南端名喚『崩隙』的這片沙土挖空了，居民被迫遷移，旗津也因而斷開 了與台灣的連繫，猶如遊子，離開了母親的懷抱。土地會消失，歷史也許會被淡忘，但曾經走過那段艱辛歲月的人們，他們的悲歡離合、笑容與淚水，仍將會轉化為孕育後代子孫的養分，開出燦爛的花朵。這是屬於我們上一代人的故事，也是我們這一代人的故事，是所有在這座島嶼上奮鬥的人們的—《

programme.title: 360行向前衝第715集
programme.desc: 360行故事多，體驗各行各業，發掘賺錢新36計。透過體驗各產業的紀錄與分享，了解各行各業的創業維艱，發掘其獨到之處、獨門技術，發現"不可思議"的新商機，以及驚人的經濟效益；或是體驗寓工作於娛樂，當個最樂在工作的幸福人，透過打工體驗瞭解與分享更多台灣不為人知的感動故事。

programme.title: 熱海戀歌第32集
programme.desc: 父母親早逝的英雄，從小就住在西螺的大舅家。一次鄉里衝突，英雄和換帖兄弟添財離家北上，進入溫泉鄉~北投，當起限時專送的機車小弟。在北投，他遇見今生唯一的摯愛秀秀。擁有天生音樂才華的他，最初學習各種樂器只是為了討秀秀歡心，最後卻因此成為名揚北投的「春風」那卡西樂團樂手。可惜兩人純真的戀情，卻遭秀秀的養父所反對，英雄卻不放棄；縱使在得知秀秀已與日本商人白原訂婚之後，英雄仍不死心，繼續穿梭在溫泉鄉崎嶇的巷道與繁華的酒宴間，彈著為秀秀所譜寫的未完成歌曲，無畏地向全世界宣誓，他要傾盡一生的光陰來愛秀秀…。在秀秀與白元的婚禮上，英雄衝到美川閣，想帶秀秀遠走高飛！畢竟深愛著英雄的秀秀，身著婚紗、不顧一切坐上他

programme.title: 美麗人生壯志高飛第428集
programme.desc: 台視60周年台慶大戲《美麗人生》第五單元《壯志高飛》，以1960年代高雄市旗津島為故事起點，三位最美麗的台灣女人，在台灣最美麗的年代，在最美麗的旗津，悲歡交織而成的美麗人生。數百年前，旗津還沒有一個統一的名稱，島的南端依舊與高雄相連。 而後，為了建造高雄港第二港口，旗津南端名喚『崩隙』的這片沙土挖空了，居民被迫遷移，旗津也因而斷開 了與台灣的連繫，猶如遊子，離開了母親的懷抱。土地會消失，歷史也許會被淡忘，但曾經走過那段艱辛歲月的人們，他們的悲歡離合、笑容與淚水，仍將會轉化為孕育後代子孫的養分，開出燦爛的花朵。這是屬於我們上一代人的故事，也是我們這一代人的故事，是所有在這座島嶼上奮鬥的人們的—《

programme.title: 同學早安第7集
programme.desc: 在家鄉玉里服務一輩子的老師「楊招治」 人生幸福組的她卻在年過半百時，失去摯愛的丈夫，面臨退休與否的抉擇。 「人生只能這樣嗎？」招治問自己。她想起家中的三老，她看見生活周遭需要幫助的靈魂，那些需要觸動了招治最溫柔的一塊心田，她知道，她的人生可以不只是這樣…

programme.title: 風月同天-5分30秒版第50集
programme.desc: 「風月同天」此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：「山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣。」意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫、共度風雨。影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影—以行動，讓愛無國界。這，就是慈濟——一個由無數人的「小善」匯聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 生活地球村第259集
programme.desc: 《生活地球村》是一個以環境、印尼當地智慧以及食物潛力為主題的紀錄片節目。本節目的製作是為了帶領觀眾意識並邀請大家在生活中實踐環保、愛護地球。

programme.title: 法華經序HD中文版第1集
programme.desc: 法華經序係花蓮靜思精舍，於每日拂曉時分，僧俗二眾的早課實錄，意在啟發自性本具的大乘精神；旨於引導大眾常行菩薩道。除心無旁騖專注於當下課誦的經文外，同時擴及日常生活每一刻的專注、培養慈悲佛心，學習縮小自我，破我執，達到清澄的空慧般若。

programme.title: 無量義經偈頌第5集
programme.desc:
《無量義經》被譽為《法華經》的前導，也是大乘佛法中最能啟發慈悲行的經典。對證嚴上人而言，這部經是畢生體悟最深的法門，更成為慈濟法脈的根本依據。在 上人的帶領下，《無量義經》成為慈濟人行入人群的實踐指南。
本節目以 上人講解的《無量義經》偈頌為主軸，帶領觀眾把經中智慧用在生活的每個當下，願人人能從這部經中啟發無量善念，為自己與社會帶來更多和諧與光亮。

programme.title: 志為人醫守護愛2.0第182集
programme.desc:
什麼是有溫度的醫療？什麼是醫療之魂？醫療團隊除了在診間、在手術室、在病房搶救生命之外，還能做些什麼？
『志為人醫守護愛』帶您目擊動人的溫馨醫病情現場，透過醫療團隊的視病如親、 以病為師的堅持、病患與醫療團隊的互相感恩，體會與感受現代人醫如何幫助病患重拾信心，在他們人生低潮時重新出發，進而走入人群，自助助人。

programme.title: 映照人生第491集
programme.desc: 印尼，是個超過兩億人口的東南亞大國，貧富差距極大，且語言文化種族差異均大。由印尼大愛臺製作的「映照人生」，報導當地各面向的社會議題，從2010年起逐年獲獎，被譽為是印尼正面紀錄片的先驅之一。 製作團隊都是由印尼的工作同仁，以在地觀點，對印尼社會做深度觀察，發現問題，報導當事人如何解決或面對，製作出一系列感人且啟發人心的故事，傳達以人道為關懷精神的節目內容。 本節目記錄著印尼底層的人們，每個勇敢迎向苦難與希望的故事；也帶領觀眾看見，這個世界的黑暗角落，因為人性的光輝，所映照出的光明。

programme.title: 法華經序HD中文版第1集
programme.desc: 法華經序係花蓮靜思精舍，於每日拂曉時分，僧俗二眾的早課實錄，意在啟發自性本具的大乘精神；旨於引導大眾常行菩薩道。除心無旁騖專注於當下課誦的經文外，同時擴及日常生活每一刻的專注、培養慈悲佛心，學習縮小自我，破我執，達到清澄的空慧般若。

《無量義經》被譽為《法華經》的前導，也是大乘佛法中最能啟發慈悲行的經典。對證嚴上人而言，這部經是畢生體悟最深的法門，更成為慈濟法脈的根本依據。在 上人的帶領下，《無量義經》成為慈濟人行入人群的實踐指南。
本節目以 上人講解的《無量義經》偈頌為主軸，帶領觀眾把經中智慧用在生活的每個當下，願人人能從這部經中啟發無量善念，為自己與社會帶來更多和諧與光亮。

programme.title: 大愛真健康第922集
programme.desc: 運動是對自己最好的投資，不只是為了瘦身、增肌，是為了更好的生活品質，每一天做一件對自己好的事，日子就會很踏實。 運動是一輩子的事，沒時間運動不是藉口，每天花三~五分鐘時間，跟著「大愛真健康」做運動，讓你愈動愈年輕、愈動愈健康！

programme.title: 大愛早安新聞 LIVE
programme.desc: 證嚴上人慈示：「新聞報導，除了『報』，還要進一步『導』，範疇要開闊，關懷普天下蒼民，為時代作見證，為人類寫歷史。」，大愛新聞透過SNG、電話連線、數位影像，傳遞全球最新訊息，堅持將人間美善訊息與人性光明面的故事至散播世界各地，發揮淨化人心功能。

programme.title: 365日日素第119集
programme.desc: 每天一道素食料理，透過簡單的烹調方式，做出健康美味的蔬食料理。

programme.title: 風月同天-5分30秒版第50集
programme.desc: 「風月同天」此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：「山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣。」意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫、共度風雨。影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影—以行動，讓愛無國界。這，就是慈濟——一個由無數人的「小善」匯聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 仁心慧語第359集
programme.desc: 真正的智慧來自於內心，由內心啟悟的智慧也最真實。證嚴 上人說：「做該做的事就是智慧，做不該做的事就是愚痴。」十個問題、十個解方，都是言者生命經驗的體現，透過名人的智慧哲理，足以啟迪人心，振聾發瞶，重新思考人生的價值。

programme.title: 蔬果生活誌第40集
programme.desc: 關於「吃」，該怎麼吃得有智慧、吃出健康和營養呢？ 瞭解臺灣不同時節、氣候的豐富物產，透過農人的智慧和汗水，告訴您食材的生命故事，並且體驗背後的價值與感動。

programme.title: 看美善學美善美善劇場第540集
programme.desc: 《多謝款待》由渡邊杏主演，東出昌大、財前直見、原田泰造、木村綠子、近藤正臣等共同出演。該劇講述了主人公芽以子從大正年間直到第二次世界大戰結束的數十年間，以飽含心意的美食支持著身邊的人，並始終堅守對丈夫的愛的故事。

programme.desc: 運動是對自己最好的投資，不只是為了瘦身、增肌，是為了更好的生活品質，每一天做一件對自己好的事，日子就會很踏實。 運動是一輩子的事，沒時間運動不是藉口，每天花三~五分鐘時間，跟著「大愛真健康」做運動，讓你愈動愈年輕、愈動愈健康！

programme.title: 無量義經偈頌第7集
programme.desc:
《無量義經》被譽為《法華經》的前導，也是大乘佛法中最能啟發慈悲行的經典。對證嚴上人而言，這部經是畢生體悟最深的法門，更成為慈濟法脈的根本依據。在 上人的帶領下，《無量義經》成為慈濟人行入人群的實踐指南。
本節目以 上人講解的《無量義經》偈頌為主軸，帶領觀眾把經中智慧用在生活的每個當下，願人人能從這部經中啟發無量善念，為自己與社會帶來更多和諧與光亮。

programme.title: 風月同天-5分30秒版第39集
programme.desc: 「風月同天」此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：「山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣。」意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫、共度風雨。影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影—以行動，讓愛無國界。這，就是慈濟——一個由無數人的「小善」匯聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 大愛學漢醫第479集
programme.desc: 讓世界看懂中醫，打破中醫的框架迷思，發揮預防重於治療的優點，讓台灣走向樂活社會。

programme.title: 人間菩提
programme.desc: 一年365天，一天15分鐘， 證嚴上人以佛心應世事，結合台灣社會脈動、全球趨勢，從後山看世界。

programme.title: 同學早安第9集
programme.desc: 在家鄉玉里服務一輩子的老師「楊招治」 人生幸福組的她卻在年過半百時，失去摯愛的丈夫，面臨退休與否的抉擇。 「人生只能這樣嗎？」招治問自己。她想起家中的三老，她看見生活周遭需要幫助的靈魂，那些需要觸動了招治最溫柔的一塊心田，她知道，她的人生可以不只是這樣…

programme.title: 大愛醫生館第6738集
programme.desc: 不斷汲取新知，已是現代人必備的條件，對於人文精神的掌握，往往顯得貧乏。大愛醫生館藉由醫師專業知識加上俯拾即是的美感經驗與與回歸人文思想的本懷，期望幫助忙碌的現代人多關心自己與周遭人的身心健康，為醫療節目注入生活化的素材。

programme.title: 慶餘年第5集
programme.desc: 某大學文學史專業的學生張慶（張若昀飾）熟讀古典名著，但他用現代觀念剖析古代文學史，透過寫小說的方式，進一步闡述自己想要表達的觀點。在他的小說中，身世神秘的少年范閑，自小跟隨奶奶生活在海邊小城澹州，隨著一位自稱老師的突然造訪，他看似平靜的生活開始直面重重的危機與考驗。上半部的劇情主要發生在京都，范閑追查牛欄街刺殺一案的幕後黑手。下半部劇情發生在北齊上京城，范閑親率南慶使團，前往北齊用戰犯肖恩交換言冰雲。但這只是，慶帝和陳萍萍佈局，想令肖恩誤以為范閑就是他失散多年的孫子，藉此套出神廟的秘密。

programme.title: MIT台灣誌第621集
programme.desc: 《MIT台灣誌》是為台灣探訪與見證前人留下歷史足跡，為台灣這塊土地留下一段完整紀錄，並參照資料照片與麥覺明口頭解說，令觀眾可以拼湊出當年歷史。在每段廣告之前，《MIT台灣誌》會出現一則專題解說，是《MIT台灣誌》另一項特色。《MIT台灣誌》除富有歷史文化探訪紀錄外，在探訪路途上會不斷探究與發現值得紀錄之事，有：生態介紹、地質變化、新物種發現、辨認動植物、山嶽特色與氣候、術語解說、人文風情寫實…等，這也見證了台灣前古後今、探史溯源的多元性紀錄，是一部具有生態教學、文化品味、社會動態與價值變化的詮釋，深深結合自台灣有開發歷史以來，歷經滄海桑田的歲月與戰爭留下的烙痕。

programme.title: 大陸尋奇第1936集
programme.desc: 大陸尋奇是台灣目前最社教節目之冠不惜巨資的大製作足跡踏遍各現代城市、窮鄉僻壤，深入各民族村落，記錄了外人難得一見的生活情況，以準確的地理、歷史定位，用現代化思維，把中華文化忠實的呈現。 漫遊在浩瀚中國的世外桃源，細賞湖光山色間的粉妝玉琢，帶您跋山涉水遊遍奇峰峻嶺，讓您看盡壯闊山河嘆為觀止。

programme.title: 唱歌給你聽第61集
programme.desc: 故事講述一個在台灣北漂的家庭，浪漫天真的父親不切實際地為這個家帶來債務、困擾與紛爭。時常失蹤的父親只能由任勞任怨的母親咬牙把這個家支撐下去。多年後四處飄浪的父親癌末回來找長大後的女兒，女兒為了處理父親的臨終把本已瓦解的家庭關係，再次找回分散各地家人，並在父親臨終前相互道歉、和解道別。

programme.title: 倚天屠龍記第2集
programme.desc: 元朝末年，屠龍寶刀再現江湖，武林各派你爭我奪，激起一場腥風血雨！武當派張翠山與天鷹教殷素素因屠龍刀而相識、相戀，成親生子，也因屠龍刀而喪命，留下孤兒張無忌。張無忌少年奇遇，修煉九陽神功有成！因禍得福，習乾坤大挪移脫險！拯救明教滅教之禍，被推舉為教主！排解六大派紛爭，誓死對抗蒙古人！。同時，蒙古郡主趙敏、峨嵋派周芷若、表妹殷離、波斯少女小昭對他的傾慕，讓他不知所措，陷入情仇不分，愛中有恨的窘境………. lt;br/> lt;br/>主要演員lt;br/>曾舜晞 飾 張無忌lt;br/>陳鈺琪 飾 趙 敏lt;br/>祝緒丹 飾 周芷若lt;br/>周海媚 飾 滅絕師太lt;br/>黑 子 飾 金毛獅王 謝 遜lt;br/>許雅

programme.title: 慶餘年第7集
programme.desc: 某大學文學史專業的學生張慶（張若昀飾）熟讀古典名著，但他用現代觀念剖析古代文學史，透過寫小說的方式，進一步闡述自己想要表達的觀點。在他的小說中，身世神秘的少年范閑，自小跟隨奶奶生活在海邊小城澹州，隨著一位自稱老師的突然造訪，他看似平靜的生活開始直面重重的危機與考驗。上半部的劇情主要發生在京都，范閑追查牛欄街刺殺一案的幕後黑手。下半部劇情發生在北齊上京城，范閑親率南慶使團，前往北齊用戰犯肖恩交換言冰雲。但這只是，慶帝和陳萍萍佈局，想令肖恩誤以為范閑就是他失散多年的孫子，藉此套出神廟的秘密。

programme.title: 台灣味道8第4集
programme.desc: 以台灣這片土地上奮鬥的小人物為主角的系列紀錄片。這些升斗小民、尋常人家為追求他們的願望、嚮往、志向、使命或執著，堅持著一種作為。這個作為，就是他們之所以活得精彩的故事，也是《台灣味道》探尋、擷取的影像題材、故事的基礎。

programme.title: MIT台灣誌第622集
programme.desc: 《MIT台灣誌》是為台灣探訪與見證前人留下歷史足跡，為台灣這塊土地留下一段完整紀錄，並參照資料照片與麥覺明口頭解說，令觀眾可以拼湊出當年歷史。在每段廣告之前，《MIT台灣誌》會出現一則專題解說，是《MIT台灣誌》另一項特色。《MIT台灣誌》除富有歷史文化探訪紀錄外，在探訪路途上會不斷探究與發現值得紀錄之事，有：生態介紹、地質變化、新物種發現、辨認動植物、山嶽特色與氣候、術語解說、人文風情寫實…等，這也見證了台灣前古後今、探史溯源的多元性紀錄，是一部具有生態教學、文化品味、社會動態與價值變化的詮釋，深深結合自台灣有開發歷史以來，歷經滄海桑田的歲月與戰爭留下的烙痕。

programme.title: 大陸尋奇第1937集
programme.desc: 大陸尋奇是台灣目前最社教節目之冠不惜巨資的大製作足跡踏遍各現代城市、窮鄉僻壤，深入各民族村落，記錄了外人難得一見的生活情況，以準確的地理、歷史定位，用現代化思維，把中華文化忠實的呈現。 漫遊在浩瀚中國的世外桃源，細賞湖光山色間的粉妝玉琢，帶您跋山涉水遊遍奇峰峻嶺，讓您看盡壯闊山河嘆為觀止。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子第6季:第407集
programme.desc: 本作品是以作者的童年（昭和49年，即1974年）生活為藍本的故事，其中一事一物均充滿著1970年代的懷舊氣息。故事發生的舞台是日本靜岡縣清水市，那是一個不折不扣的美麗港都，是個交通便利、漁產豐富、又與富士山為鄰的好地方。故事圍繞著小丸子以及其家人和同學展開，有關於親情、友誼等，或是一些生活小事，但當中有笑有淚，令人回想起童年的稚氣。

programme.title: 霹靂靖玄錄下闋第5集
programme.desc: 皇禍再起，逆世雙鱗重磅襲捲南域，焚夜天祭，風月主人召喚火隕滅世，昔日劫難再次降臨，軒昂五璣各自傷亡，儒道頂峰身無餘力，傳說中的恆山．劍謫仙，如今身在何處？他能再現江湖，扛起蒼生這面大旗嗎？

programme.title: 野球名人房第59集
programme.desc: NOWnews Podcast節目《野球名人房》上線啦！全新企劃以棒球為主軸，在節目中要分享各種你最想知道的棒球話題，不論是「想當年的那一場球」、「傳奇球星近況」、還是大家最喜歡的「爆料大會」應有盡有！當然本節目的主持人也是大有來頭，由「叫你總欸出來打」東哥黃忠義以及「活潑女星」何美搭檔主持

programme.title: 霹靂謎城之九輪異譜第45集

programme.title: 天子傳奇第13集
programme.desc: 商朝第二十八代君－紂王，好大喜功，征戰連連，百姓為其榷稅徵租，貧乏窮困，哀聲載道，民心漸失。一日在平魔的慶功宴時，代表大商國運的鎮國龍龜猝亡，適時西現紫氣，紂王視為必是西出妖孽，足以禍國，便遣妖帥調領大軍征剿西岐。 西伯侯姬昌第二子名曰姬發，出世時天空出現異象，百姓皆稱其為未來聖主。姬昌算易知悉姬發有九九之命格危在旦夕，便挺險施行九鼎奇法，卻因妖帥與九大護衛殺入，反成九五至尊之數。大祭司見弄巧成拙，建請紂王宣召姬發上京面聖，藉機要將姬發煉製靈人，代替護國祥物，紂王為保王命，想盡辦法不擇手段，導致天怒人怨，因此種下亡國敗運的禍根。 姬發面聖路上，災劫連連，有飄渺城之困，卻因禍得福習得「渾天寶

programme.title: 護心第40集
programme.desc: 靈龍天曜懷著滿心喜悅準備和廣寒門掌門素影成親，誰知素影另有圖謀，她計畫取龍鱗制一件龍鱗鎧甲，為護她真正所愛之人不傷不死，卻不想天曜拼死在最後一刻將凝聚巨大靈力的護心鱗打出，素影大怒，將天曜的不死之身肢解，封印于大江南北。護心鱗飛躍山河，落入了一心口缺失的棄嬰雁回胸膛，填補了雁回心臟缺失，讓她得以活命。十年後，流浪的雁回被辰星山掌門淩霄收養，納入辰星山成為他的弟子。因識海未開，靈力全無，仍是一星弟子，因此被同門嘲笑。一次偶然的機會，觸發了雁回心口護心鱗的力量，靈龍之火瞬間燒毀了鎖妖塔的結界，塔內的妖族趁機逃跑。淩霄得知後將其趕出辰星山，雁回誤解了師父，覺得道不同不相為謀，便瀟灑下山去永州成找好朋

programme.title: 我的女俠羅明依第1集
programme.desc: 在明朝嘉靖年間，羅明依從小崇拜百年前下西洋的三寶太監，渴望未來也能航海遠洋。明依的師兄李時珍牽涉宮廷陰謀，遭到錦衣衛畢正追殺。明依冒險救出李時珍，與畢正在山洞內激戰，一道閃電降臨，將明依和畢正穿越到現代的新加坡……

programme.title: 霹靂靖玄錄下闋第7集
programme.desc: 皇禍再起，逆世雙鱗重磅襲捲南域，焚夜天祭，風月主人召喚火隕滅世，昔日劫難再次降臨，軒昂五璣各自傷亡，儒道頂峰身無餘力，傳說中的恆山．劍謫仙，如今身在何處？他能再現江湖，扛起蒼生這面大旗嗎？

programme.title: 100種不老生活第7集

programme.title: 包青天第22集
programme.desc: 包拯為北宋仁宗天聖五年（1027年）申科進士甲科，初任建昌知縣，官至開封府尹及龍圖閣大學士，這跟電視上演的倒是相同。包拯是古代中國清官的典型代表，後世包括朱熹、歐陽修、司馬光對他都有正面評價。宋仁宗年間，開封府尹包拯，通稱「包青天」。為官清廉，為民伸冤，強調「人在做天在看」、「舉頭三尺有神明」不畏強權，除惡務盡。較膾炙人口的單元有「秦香蓮」、「真假狀元」、「貍貓換太子」等。

programme.title: 包青天第24集
programme.desc: 包拯為北宋仁宗天聖五年（1027年）申科進士甲科，初任建昌知縣，官至開封府尹及龍圖閣大學士，這跟電視上演的倒是相同。包拯是古代中國清官的典型代表，後世包括朱熹、歐陽修、司馬光對他都有正面評價。宋仁宗年間，開封府尹包拯，通稱「包青天」。為官清廉，為民伸冤，強調「人在做天在看」、「舉頭三尺有神明」不畏強權，除惡務盡。較膾炙人口的單元有「秦香蓮」、「真假狀元」、「貍貓換太子」等。

programme.desc: 單元多，可創造明快的節目節奏！不同的單元，猶如一個個不一樣的抽屜，彼此的區隔明確清楚。 多樣的單元，各有各的教育目標及觀賞樂趣。不一樣的孩子可以找到自己喜歡和認同的單元。幼兒的學習並非邏輯式的。單元式的學習方式，更能符合幼兒的學習與發展。綜合雜誌型態的節目類型，可以針對幼兒做全方位的生活學習。

programme.title: 公視早安新聞第47集
programme.desc: 《公視早安新聞》（Good Morning Taiwan, PTS）是公共電視文化事業基金會新聞部製播的晨間新聞節目，於2016年6月6日開播。本節目開播時，為國英雙語節目，其中前半小時以國語播報、後半小時為以英語播報的《Good Morning Taiwan, PTS》。2017年7月31日起，公視早安新聞改為全程國語播報，而英語新聞改為週一至週五播出的《公視英語新聞》（《PTS English News》）。

programme.title: 公視手語新聞第35集
programme.desc: 公視手語新聞將轉型！擴大對聽障者的服務，將原「公視手語新聞」改版轉型為更具資訊性與生活化的新聞節目「手語資訊站」，用輕鬆方式「看見」生活新聞資訊。另將推出專為聽障朋友量身打造的單元「手語新聞通」，結合新聞小辭典以及每日一手語的特性，透過手語主播以及新聞畫面或字幕說明，正確解釋近日新聞焦點，讓聽障朋友清楚新聞脈絡，也讓觀眾學正確的手語。

programme.title: 公視越南語新聞第35集
programme.desc: 《公視越南語新聞》是一個針對越南語觀眾的新聞節目，提供最新、全面的國內外新聞報導，涵蓋政治、經濟、社會、文化等多方面的重要議題，讓觀眾在母語中深入了解世界各地的時事動態。

programme.title: 公視印尼語新聞第35集
programme.desc: 《公視印尼語新聞》是一個專注於印尼語觀眾的新聞節目，提供最新的印尼本土與國際新聞報導，讓觀眾獲得全球時事、文化和政治等多方面的深入了解與連結。

programme.title: 公視泰語新聞第35集
programme.desc: 《公視泰語新聞》是一個為泰語觀眾製作的新聞節目，提供最即時和全面的國內外新聞報導，讓觀眾深入瞭解泰國和世界各地的時事、政治、經濟、文化等重要議題。

programme.title: 在親密與孤獨間漂流的愛情第1集
programme.desc: 江宗佑是一個大型雕塑藝術家，他有一個美麗而能幹的太太，平日幫他料理所有的生活起居及展出業務，甚至連宗佑離婚的前妻以及的獨生子，都是由這位現任太太照管。每一年江宗佑都會為獨子辦一個盛大的生日慶會，這一天，美麗的太太正在籌辦這個生日晚宴的途中，巧遇了她自己的前夫，一切的曲折由此開始。

programme.title: 我的狗男友第1集
programme.desc: 吃過狗罐頭嗎？我沒吃過；但有人吃太久的狗罐頭，就不自覺變成一隻狗。這種可能性，會不會發生呢？戲劇裡甚麼都有可能。身邊多了一位狗男友，這樣的處境，會不會是一個戀愛中的少女最難面對的一件事？男人變成狗，女人會怎麼想，驚嚇大於驚喜。只是男人不是寵物；但寵物不會是人類，兩者怎說都不通。女孩遇到一個很爛的男友，結果給他吃狗罐頭做的料理，結果這男人就變成一隻狗了。如此戲劇的轉變也讓女孩有機會圓自己的夢。學法文。只不過好女孩的愛情並不幸福，真正的幸福他還在尋找。至於壞男孩的下場就是被自己不負責任的態度所害，自討苦吃進醫院囉。只不過不是他變成狗，而是比狗還要悽慘。女孩去了自己夢想的國度：法國。一圓她的未來。

programme.title: 亞洲第7集
programme.desc: 探索亞洲壯麗的野生景觀，從沙漠到叢林、極地到珊瑚海，展現珍稀動物與城市野生生態，並聚焦保護自然的保育英雄。

programme.title: 公視午間新聞第56集

programme.title: 我的婆婆怎麼那麼可愛第33集
programme.desc: 小鷗（奚伊鷗）是蘇家最小的媳婦，不幸在進門前後，公公跟老公就相繼掛掉，使她完全不得夫家人心。守寡的小鷗也巴不得不再跟婆家有任何牽連，但天不從人願，命運使她跟婆婆越走越近。一天婆婆邀她回去吃中秋飯，她以為婆婆好意，沒想到是要她簽字放棄丈夫的壽險繼承，而由買保險的婆婆受益。她氣得要劃清界線，結果意外發現夫家的餅舖珍賀齋即將面臨關門的命運，婆婆要北上依靠三子一女度過晚年。小鷗假裝事不關己，卻陸續聽到幾個兒女像詐騙集團一樣訛詐婆婆的養老金，激起她的同情心，想幫婆婆一把。落到無家可歸的彩香急需幫助，但援手來自於這不得她疼的媳婦，她又拉不下臉。經由烘焙師發貴的巧妙牽引，小鷗跟彩香約定不以婆媳關係，而以事業

programme.title: 牛車來去第1集

programme.title: 行走TIT第270集

programme.desc: 健康是國家繁榮和個人生活的基石，而運動是保持健康的關鍵。因此，公共電視與教育部攜手合作，策劃了一個名為《就是愛運動》的節目。透過每一集的介紹，我們希望讓觀眾更深入了解國內各項體育發展的情況，並培養對運動的熱愛和支持。同時，我們也期望能夠激發觀眾對運動的興趣，並鼓勵他們積極參與運動。

programme.title: 公視晚間新聞第56集

programme.desc: 公共電視新聞部的十多名記者與工作人員，將回到自己的頻道，開闢一個兼具調查採訪和新聞雜誌性質的新聞專題節目，「獨立特派員」。 調查性或雜誌型態的電視新聞專題節目，往往是一個電視台的新聞實力指標。為了在公共電視開闢調查性的新聞專題節目，服務更多觀眾，我們將以「新聞專題節目的領導品牌」為目標，回到公視頻道製播獨立、深度的調查性報導，以及提供多元、寬廣視野的新聞專題。

programme.title: 人浮於愛第3集
programme.desc: 在周曉琪眼中，愛情可被金錢衡量。她與富商詹董為公開情人，卻在心理諮商時遇見精神科醫師顧厚澤，喚醒深埋慾望，陷入道德與情感的糾葛。平凡上班族潘心彤歷經情場與職場打擊，意外邂逅辛毅夫，重燃希望，卻因身分懸殊再度受考驗。兩段情感交織，揭開愛與選擇的真相。

programme.title: 載我回甲仙第1集

programme.title: 樹人大冒險第1集
programme.desc: 尤瑪想去市集欣賞漂亮的首飾，但是哥哥尤命顧慮她的安危，嚴格禁止她亂跑。被限制行動的妹妹非常生氣，甚至用力咬了哥哥一口，甩開哥哥跑進了森林裡的山洞。尤瑪和尤命進入了樹人世界，而這次哥哥尤命卻被魔法命中，變成了「樹人」！憂心的妹妹只好擔起拯救哥哥的責任，踏上異世界的驚奇之旅！為了讓哥哥恢復原狀，他們必須從「鐵鋸魔」手中拯救「花精公主」；在這趟冒險的旅程，尤瑪也將深深了解哥哥對自己的愛。

programme.title: 暗夜新聞第55集
programme.desc: 暗夜客話新聞是全國唯一主播、記者以全客語發音的新聞頻道，並 詳實顯示字幕，除了著眼於「客家觀點」的重要新聞議題、呈現客家生活 習俗與傳統文化之外，更盡力發掘社會各階層客家鄉親的故事。暗夜客話新聞針對四節新聞播出鏡面，以桐花、藍衫等各種不同主題的客家元素為基礎，作全面的視覺設計，讓收視大眾們能夠耳目一新、零時差的掌握，最具客家觀點的新聞呈現。

programme.title: 星空下的黑潮島嶼第2集
programme.desc: 黑暗中有去無回，但只要有一點光，就能在黑暗中走得更遠。

programme.title: 村民大會-過家尞聊正事第80集
programme.desc: 打造一台行動雜貨店，駛入客庄大街小巷，歡迎鄉親一起來喝茶聊天，暢談地方議題，大人小孩都來「過家尞聊正事」，關心客庄大小事！

programme.title: 福氣來了第4集
programme.desc: 為一民生消費資訊的訪談性節目，邀請知名中西醫療專家、營養師，為鄉親解惑；更結合運動養身，教學瑜珈、太極和律動等項目。同時，也會介紹客莊各地的活動、農特產品、表演團體等，要給觀眾們滿滿的一朝晨。

programme.title: 幕後有藝思第10集
programme.desc: 《幕後有藝思》 邀您探索幕後大小事!

programme.title: 日頭下‧月光光第127集
programme.desc: 此齣為與生活資訊結合的客家戲劇，客語口說藝術的劇場，其中包含了相聲竹板快書、以及說文解字，用活潑逗趣的表演方式，來傳達客家語言，敬請觀眾鎖定收看！

programme.title: 國際新聞-客觀世界第48集
programme.desc: 是一個專注於國際時事的新聞節目，以客觀、中立的角度報導全球各地的重要新聞事件。節目內容涵蓋政治、經濟、社會、文化等多方面的議題，旨在向觀眾傳遞真實可信的消息，讓觀眾全面了解世界各地的動態，增進對國際事務的理解和視野。

programme.title: 停動停動好健康第293集
programme.desc: 《停動停動好健康》是一個關注身體健康的節目，通過介紹和推廣健康的生活方式和運動方法，鼓勵觀眾在日常生活中停下腳步，注重運動和健康飲食，增進身體健康和心靈幸福，提高生活質量。這個節目旨在激發觀眾對健康的關注和重視，讓人們更好地照顧自己的身心健康。

programme.title: 奧林p客第1601集
programme.desc: 在新的對話中，主持人和機器人阿藍妹將增加科技互動的元素。參賽孩子們將扮演小博士的角色，從各種主題和發明中學習現代科學和未來科技。每一集將以「一大六小」的競賽形式進行，並引入四選一的卡牌抽選機制，讓孩子們學習團隊合作，並在面對不同意見時學會溝通和做出抉擇。

programme.title: 魔法小廚師第15集
programme.desc: 講述在特魯利城堡裡，四名主角的美食冒險故事，主角們的老師熱愛烹飪，擁有一本珍貴的祖傳食譜，按照食譜還原美食是他們主要學習目標，而在製作每一道美味料理的過程中，小廚師們漸漸也學會了許多人生中的智慧。但壞心眼的大鬍子阿庫伯總會出現費盡心思想不勞而獲，因此必要時大家會使出魔法阻止大鬍子的詭計，他們隱藏著神祕身分默默守護王國。

programme.title: 魔法小廚師第16集

programme.title: 村民大會-過家尞聊正事第80集

programme.title: 福氣來了第4集
programme.desc: 為一民生消費資訊的訪談性節目，邀請知名中西醫療專家、營養師，為鄉親解惑；更結合運動養身，教學瑜珈、太極和律動等項目。同時，也會介紹客莊各地的活動、農特產品、表演團體等，要給觀眾們滿滿的一朝晨。

programme.title: 我把旅行變成一道菜第7集
programme.desc: 《我把旅行變成一道菜》是一個獨特的旅遊節目，節目主持人將以烹飪的方式，將旅行的經歷和感受轉化為美食的創作。每集節目中，主持人會前往不同的目的地，體驗當地文化、美景和人文風情，並在回來後將所見所聞融入菜餚的烹飪過程中，創造出一道道獨特而有趣的美食。這個節目旨在將旅行和美食相結合，帶給觀眾視覺和味覺的雙重享受，同時也讓觀眾感受到旅行和飲食之間的深刻聯繫。

programme.title: 昆蟲捉迷藏第4集
programme.desc: 我們將帶您重新認識昆蟲世界。昆蟲是與人類最親近的生物之一，我們曾經與它們有過親密的接觸。然而，隨著年紀增長和忙碌的生活，我們可能已經遺忘了這些回憶，甚至因為對昆蟲的陌生和不了解而留下了負面印象。透過重新認識一隻蝴蝶幼蟲，我們將帶您認識葉子、花朵、樹木、森林以及生命的蛻變。這將改變您對生命的看法，並激發您對自然的興趣和

programme.title: 當晝新聞第56集
programme.desc: 《當晝新聞》是一個日間新聞節目，提供即時、全面的國內外新聞報導，涵蓋政治、經濟、社會、文化等多方面的重要議題。這個節目專注於在白天時段向觀眾傳遞當下最重要的新聞資訊，讓觀眾隨時掌握時事動向，並對眾多議題保持關注和理解。無論是政治動盪、經濟變化，或者社會事件和文化創新，這個節目都將為觀眾帶來最及時的報導和解析。

programme.title: 大自然生趣第21集
programme.desc: 你知道台灣原生的鹿科動物總共有幾種嗎？你知道留鳥與夏候鳥的差別嗎？你知道「南路鷹一萬死九千」這句話的由來嗎？你知道有哪些鳥是父親負責孵蛋跟照顧小孩呢？ 請共下來瞭解，《大自然生趣》。 《大自然生趣》，照字面意思來說，是自然界中生生不息的各種生物所帶來的許多趣味。很湊巧的，「生趣」這兩個字，其實這是客語「有趣」的發音，因此換成客語來說，就是「大自然真有趣」。這個節目是將客籍生態紀錄片導演劉燕明先生三十餘年來上山下海，辛苦拍攝所得的豐富生態影像，以每集5分鐘之短篇製作成有趣又具生態教育意義的短片，具有兩大特色：1.生態專業團隊製作：導演劉燕明先生與撰稿、旁白的鄧慶煜先生，兩人皆具備生態與紀錄片拍

programme.title: ㄤ牯ㄤ牯咕咕咕(饒平腔)第159集
programme.desc: 「ㄤ牯ㄤ牯咕咕咕」是一個以四位好朋友為主角的故事，他們在一起時會有對話、爭吵、歡笑，並共同創造出許多故事情節。

programme.title: 誰來作客第81集
programme.desc: 一個以「客」為尊的節目，邀請嘉賓以輕鬆閒聊的方式閒話家常。

programme.title: 當晝新聞第57集
programme.desc: 《當晝新聞》是一個日間新聞節目，提供即時、全面的國內外新聞報導，涵蓋政治、經濟、社會、文化等多方面的重要議題。這個節目專注於在白天時段向觀眾傳遞當下最重要的新聞資訊，讓觀眾隨時掌握時事動向，並對眾多議題保持關注和理解。無論是政治動盪、經濟變化，或者社會事件和文化創新，這個節目都將為觀眾帶來最及時的報導和解析。

programme.title: 大自然生趣第22集
programme.desc: 你知道台灣原生的鹿科動物總共有幾種嗎？你知道留鳥與夏候鳥的差別嗎？你知道「南路鷹一萬死九千」這句話的由來嗎？你知道有哪些鳥是父親負責孵蛋跟照顧小孩呢？ 請共下來瞭解，《大自然生趣》。 《大自然生趣》，照字面意思來說，是自然界中生生不息的各種生物所帶來的許多趣味。很湊巧的，「生趣」這兩個字，其實這是客語「有趣」的發音，因此換成客語來說，就是「大自然真有趣」。這個節目是將客籍生態紀錄片導演劉燕明先生三十餘年來上山下海，辛苦拍攝所得的豐富生態影像，以每集5分鐘之短篇製作成有趣又具生態教育意義的短片，具有兩大特色：1.生態專業團隊製作：導演劉燕明先生與撰稿、旁白的鄧慶煜先生，兩人皆具備生態與紀錄片拍

programme.title: 愛的辛香料第11集
programme.desc: 19世紀的泰國，一對姊妹進入宮廷御膳房學習料理。姊姊萬德活潑外向，妹妹安諾溫柔賢淑。她們努力生活，創造美味料理，也抓住愛人的心。

programme.title: 客家戲曲第1163集
programme.desc: 由多個著名客家劇團，分別演出相當膾炙人口的小說故事，希望能讓大家再次回味童年看戲的滋味，也能讓更多人欣賞到客家的傳統大戲。

programme.title: 一家之煮第440集
programme.desc: 走訪客莊邀請兩組家庭進行對決，藉由家人間的默契一起做料理，品嚐彼此完成的美食，進而帶領觀眾了解「感動人」的客家文化及地方特色食材或時令蔬果。

programme.title: 福氣來了(南方篇)第8集
programme.desc: 《福氣來了 南方篇》將延伸至中南部及花東地區，透過節目提供平台，讓鄉親朋友能夠走進攝影棚，分享他們的故事，並進行互相交流。在東南部的客家庄裡，我們能夠欣賞到獨特的生活方式，美麗如畫的田園風光以及多元的文化。讓我們在這個地方，暢談鄉親們的人生故事。

programme.title: 拉拉雜雜有土伯第15集
programme.desc: (2020)「拉拉雜雜」意指各式各樣、玲瑯滿目。「拉拉雜雜有土伯」內容為客家電視獨創，代表各項客家文化的客家寶寶為主角，打造一個網紅經紀公司，每一個客家寶寶都是一位YouTuber，他們以客家疊字來詮釋多樣又有趣...

programme.title: 奧林p客第1605集
programme.desc: 在新的對話中，主持人和機器人阿藍妹將增加科技互動的元素。參賽孩子們將扮演小博士的角色，從各種主題和發明中學習現代科學和未來科技。每一集將以「一大六小」的競賽形式進行，並引入四選一的卡牌抽選機制，讓孩子們學習團隊合作，並在面對不同意見時學會溝通和做出抉擇。

programme.desc: 暗夜客話新聞是全國唯一主播、記者以全客語發音的新聞頻道，並 詳實顯示字幕，除了著眼於「客家觀點」的重要新聞議題、呈現客家生活 習俗與傳統文化之外，更盡力發掘社會各階層客家鄉親的故事。暗夜客話新聞針對四節新聞播出鏡面，以桐花、藍衫等各種不同主題的客家元素為基礎，作全面的視覺設計，讓收視大眾們能夠耳目一新、零時差的掌握，最具客家觀點的新聞呈現。

programme.desc: 延續「客家製譟」音樂盛典品牌，2025年結合實境拍攝全新打造「初心。登場」系列節目，團隊跨越近一年時間紀錄八組音樂人回歸創作初心，挑戰前所未有的「第一次」登台。從平均年齡最年輕的樂團到搖滾天后，從獨立另類到流行經典，囊括金曲得主、經典唱將、演唱團體、亮眼新秀，多樣曲風加上最感動的創作初心，聯手專業團隊打造出耗資千萬的演唱會！

programme.title: 橙蜜香第1集
programme.desc: 2002年台灣加入WTO，農村門戶大開，有菸城之稱的高雄美濃，也因菸葉保證價格收購政策的結束，讓兩千多公頃的菸田面積急欲尋求一條生路，2004年橙蜜香番茄引進美濃，經過農民多年摸索後，創造出一年六億元以上的產值，不僅為美濃創造一線生機，同時也開啟青年返鄉的大門。

programme.title: 舊貨獵人第20季:第8集
programme.desc: 德魯普里察是個現代的尋寶人。面對挑剔的客戶和高流通率，擁有英國最大的裝飾藝品回收場，德魯經常前往英國各地尋找被人遺棄的珍寶和古物。德魯喜歡尋寶的刺激，他在缺乏建築美學的地方大肆搜刮，再帶回店裡請他的菁英修復團隊為這些古老珍寶賦予新生

programme.title: 倉儲挖寶王第1季:第6集
programme.desc: 艾倫和湯來到加州好萊塢的倉儲挖寶，成功買到三間倉庫，一間裡面裝滿了古董家具，一間只有不起眼的箱子和公事包，最後一間則是有裝書的箱子和一般的桌子。

programme.title: 恐龍化石挖寶人第2季:第8集
programme.desc: 冬天迫近，今年的恐龍挖掘季即將結束。在蒙大拿州，克雷頓的好友莎娜在促進立法上的努力，幫助克雷頓解決了決鬥雙龍纏訟多年的問題。克雷頓本季的最後一項任務，就是回報莎娜，幫忙她透過直升機，從山巔與峽谷吊出兩個三角龍頭骨。在新墨西哥州，安德烈及時在暴雨來臨前撤離猛瑪象遺址，並且修築攔水壩、改變小溪河道，避免溪水直接灌入遺址，以待明年回來挖掘。回到德州開始清修挖出的猛瑪象牙，亞柏克隆畢夫婦專程過去看驚人成果。在蒙大拿州，角龍遺址已挖出60%的骨頭，達成今年找到完整樣本的目標。牛仔暴龍的頭骨也清修組合完成，不久即出現有興趣的買家，進入簽訂合約階段，售出牛仔暴龍的目標也即將達成。

programme.title: 台灣製造大解密第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 世界上一些最真實最靠得住的電動槍已經在台灣生產超過30年，ICS公司每一年都會進一步加強槍枝的真實性、操控性和客製化。目前台灣自行車製造商生產的客製款，每輛價值數千元。自行車的靈魂在於車架，我們來中台灣的一家工廠，製作車架的材料使用鈦和不鏽鋼管材。台灣製造的牛奶糖和食用口香糖，其實源自於食物入口不出的文化禁忌。牛奶糖之所以叫牛奶糖，就是因為它加了很多奶粉跟煉乳，然後經過蒸煮產生特殊的香味；那明膠簡單講，就是可以吞的口香糖的一種原料。許多台灣和全世界的汽車車胎皆在台灣製作。這裡是這家公司在北台灣的工廠，佔地17萬平方公尺，所有的複雜化學成分，要在這裡開始組合。TCI是台灣一家重要的生物科技公司，

programme.title: 理查哈蒙玩很大第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 本集節目將帶觀眾探索全球最大的汽車工廠，理查哈蒙這回來到德國的沃爾夫斯堡，造訪汽車業龍頭福斯的生產工廠。這座工廠非常龐大，占地面積是摩納哥的三倍，需要長達六十公里的鐵路網串聯，員工從大門進去後，還得搭乘巴士才能抵達自己的工作定點；而產能更是非常驚人，一年就可以生產八十萬輛汽車，相當於每十六秒就有一部新車誕生。除此之外，這座工廠還有自己的旅館、足球隊和交響樂團，甚至還有一座香腸工廠，每年生產的香腸數量竟然超過全球的福斯產能，為的就是激勵廠內高達六萬三千名的員工，大家才能以最高效率工作。

programme.title: 富豪谷底求翻身-東山再起第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 本集的主角是上一季中給了葛倫第一份工作的強恩。他拿身家去抵押，買下一間橡膠工廠，後來橡膠製品訂單不斷下滑，於是他也開始製造狗狗玩具；經葛倫觀察，強恩這27天內要加強改進的地方就是業務能力和公司現代化。無路可退的強恩能否將公司轉型成功，並且為他的狗狗玩具釣到大客戶呢？

programme.title: 翻新中古車-世界巡迴第2季:第6集
programme.desc: 墨西哥越野金龜 在全英國翻新了上百輛令人驚艷的中古車後，邁克布魯爾和馬克艾維斯普力斯利迎接新的挑戰。他們即將展開環球巡迴冒險，入手、修復、賣出世界上最經典的車子，像是法拉利348、澳洲Holden衝浪車。在這趟史詩級公路之旅中，邁克和艾維斯沉浸在各個國家的汽車文化中，結識不可思議的人物、參與精彩的活動並探尋當地的專業。最重要的是，他們使用翻新中古車的老經驗來拯救每台車，打造可以賣出好價錢的好車

programme.title: 金礦的賭注遠征篇第6季:第5集
programme.desc: 派克雪納普和他的團隊來到南美洲的玻利維亞，那裡有許多未開採地。他們前往提歐朋特外的小鎮瓜奈，深入馬里亞普和馬皮里河流域，看到許多當地採金人和採金作業，並親自操作機具、動手盤洗。

programme.title: 金礦的賭注-救星佛萊迪第2季:第3集

programme.title: 舊貨獵人第19季:第8集
programme.desc: 德魯和艾爾一同上路尋找物件，此行德魯傾囊相授，讓艾爾獲益良多。

programme.title: 舊貨獵人修復篇第2季:第1集
programme.desc: 德魯找到一把維多利亞時代的牙醫椅，雖然拿回來時已經支離破碎，但經過皮革修復專家馬汀的巧手，以及工程師波的精湛工藝，讓這張椅子得以重現百年前的風華。法式拋光師艾利克斯這次與另一位舊貨商羅伯合作，羅伯和德魯一樣，同樣不會給艾利克斯輕鬆的工作，羅伯帶來一個搖搖欲墜，已經有三百年歷史的五斗櫃，但經過艾利克斯鬼斧神工的手藝，讓這個五斗櫃起死回生。

programme.title: 翻新中古車第12季:第5集
programme.desc: 這回麥克要尋找1970年代生產的古怪汽車，AMC佩瑟，最後在聖荷西便宜買到。艾德為這款怪車設計出獨一無二的包膜設計,最後卻不得麥克的歡心。

programme.title: 人體不思議第6季:第6集
programme.desc: 本集的節目內容包括臉部增生巨大腫瘤的青年將尋求醫生協助，希望將有性命威脅的腫瘤割除；一名皮膚對光線過敏的女子得小心翼翼地生活在黑暗中，提防隨時都可能復發的皮膚癌；天生下肢嚴重萎縮的少年首次向醫生求助，期望有朝一日得以站起來以雙腳行走。

programme.title: 翻新中古車-世界巡迴第2季:第7集
programme.desc: 墨西哥越野金龜 在全英國翻新了上百輛令人驚艷的中古車後，邁克布魯爾和馬克艾維斯普力斯利迎接新的挑戰。他們即將展開環球巡迴冒險，入手、修復、賣出世界上最經典的車子，像是法拉利348、澳洲Holden衝浪車。在這趟史詩級公路之旅中，邁克和艾維斯沉浸在各個國家的汽車文化中，結識不可思議的人物、參與精彩的活動並探尋當地的專業。最重要的是，他們使用翻新中古車的老經驗來拯救每台車，打造可以賣出好價錢的好車

programme.title: 金礦的賭注遠征篇第6季:第5集
programme.desc: 派克雪納普和他的團隊來到南美洲的玻利維亞，那裡有許多未開採地。他們前往提歐朋特外的小鎮瓜奈，深入馬里亞普和馬皮里河流域，看到許多當地採金人和採金作業，並親自操作機具、動手盤洗。

programme.title: 舊貨獵人第19季:第8集
programme.desc: 德魯和艾爾一同上路尋找物件，此行德魯傾囊相授，讓艾爾獲益良多。

programme.title: 翻新中古車第12季:第5集
programme.desc: 這回麥克要尋找1970年代生產的古怪汽車，AMC佩瑟，最後在聖荷西便宜買到。艾德為這款怪車設計出獨一無二的包膜設計,最後卻不得麥克的歡心。

programme.title: 理查哈蒙玩很大第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 本集節目將帶觀眾探訪美軍的巨無霸超級銀河運輸機；雄偉的C-5M超級銀河運輸機，幾乎可以容納軍方所需的所有東西，幫忙把軍備或人道救援物資運送到世界各地。但讓這麼龐大的飛機平穩地在空中飛行，必須掌握許多訣竅，例如飛行前務必計算貨艙重心，因為每次載貨的重心都會改變，若重心偏移運輸機可能就會飛不起來，甚至還會嚴重影響飛安。此外，即使是這麼大的運輸機，偶爾還是可能遇到燃料不足的情況，這時就需要加油機前來支援，執行驚險的空中加油任務，這可是非常考驗駕駛飛行能力的時刻。

programme.title: 金礦的賭注-救星佛萊迪第2季:第3集
programme.desc: 佛萊迪和璜前往愛達荷州，嘗試幫助三名年輕礦工轉虧為盈，尤其是三個家庭的所有希望都寄託在這項採礦作業上。

programme.title: 舊貨獵人修復篇第2季:第1集
programme.desc: 德魯找到一把維多利亞時代的牙醫椅，雖然拿回來時已經支離破碎，但經過皮革修復專家馬汀的巧手，以及工程師波的精湛工藝，讓這張椅子得以重現百年前的風華。法式拋光師艾利克斯這次與另一位舊貨商羅伯合作，羅伯和德魯一樣，同樣不會給艾利克斯輕鬆的工作，羅伯帶來一個搖搖欲墜，已經有三百年歷史的五斗櫃，但經過艾利克斯鬼斧神工的手藝，讓這個五斗櫃起死回生。

programme.title: 金礦的賭注遠征篇第6季:第6集
programme.desc: 本集節目中，派克追蹤地質學家提供的線索，來到坐落在安地斯山脈金礦帶上的波南札礦區，經過幾次好壞不一的盤洗結果，派克決定打造溜洗槽，進行成批抽樣。

programme.title: 絕地伐木勇士第2季:第6集
programme.desc: 自古以來，伐木一直是人類生活的重要產業，時至今日，仍是世界上最危險的工作之一。樹越大，風險越高...報酬也越可觀。在太平洋西北地區，伐木工傑瑞德道格拉斯帶著團隊，採伐世界上最巨大、最有價值的樹種之一：北美檜木。但要把這些體積跟巴士一樣大的巨木，從森林運送到市場一點也不容易。不僅需要高超的鋸木功夫、規模龐大的機械設備，還要有在地表最嚴酷環境上工的勇氣。

programme.title: 舊貨獵人第19季:第9集
programme.desc: 德魯本週帶領薇琪四處奔走，前往薇琪從未接觸或體驗過的舊貨古董地點。

programme.title: 古董商大挑戰第1季:第8集
programme.desc: 彤恩與艾德幫火車廂度假屋業者莉茲找火車觀看椅，彤恩勝。塔希與喬恩幫酒吧老闆班傑明找古玩裝飾酒吧，塔希贏。
